class numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.function_vd.FunctionOfVariableDimension(times=None, values=None)¶

A class for functions of variable dimension.

A class to represent a function of variable dimension defined by time-value pairs.

times¶

A list of time points of the function.

Type:

list

values¶

A list of corresponding values at the given time points.

Type:

list

add_values(times, values)¶

Adds new time-value pairs to the function.

Parameters:

  • times (float, list or array-like) – The new time(s) to add.

  • values (float, list or array-like) – The new value(s) corresponding to the times.

concatenate(other)¶

Concatenates this function with another function of variable dimension.

Parameters:

other (FunctionOfVariableDimension) – The function to concatenate with.

Returns:

func – The concatenated function.

Return type:

FunctionOfVariableDimension

Raises:

  • TypeError – If the other object is not a function of variable dimension.

  • ValueError – If the dimensions of the functions do not match at overlap.

delete_values(times=None, values=None, indices=None)¶

Deletes time-value pairs from the function.

If nothing is provided to the function, it deletes the last time-value pair. Otherwise, the time and/or value and/or index of the time-value pair to be deleted, can be provided.

Parameters:

  • times (float or list, optional) – The time(s) to delete.

  • values (list, optional) – The value(s) to delete.

  • indices (int or list, optional) – The indices of the pairs to delete.

Raises:

  • ValueError – If a time to be deleted is a dimension jump time or a given time-value(-index) pair is not part of the function.

  • TypeError – If input types do not match, i.e. one time, but multiple values and/or indices are provided.

dimension(t=None)¶

Returns the dimension of the function at given time(s).

Returns the dimension of the function at the given time(s) or the dimensions at all times, if no time is provided.

Parameters:

t (float, list, or None, optional) – The time point(s) at which to evaluate the dimension.

Returns:

dimension_values – The dimensions at the requested times.

Return type:

list

Raises:

TypeError – If t is not array-like nor a number.

dimension_jump_times(return_index=False)¶

Returns the times at which dimension jumps occur.

Parameters:

return_index (bool, optional) – If True, also return the indices of the dimension jump times.

Returns:

  • dimension_jump_times (list) – The times at which dimension jumps occur.

  • indices (list, optional) – The indices of the dimension jump times, if requested.

jump_times(return_index=False)¶

Returns the times at which jumps occur in the function.

Parameters:

return_index (bool, optional) – If True, also return the indices of the jump times.

Returns:

  • jump_times (list) – The times at which jumps occur.

  • indices (list, optional) – The indices of the jump times, if requested.

left_limit(t)¶

Returns the left limit(s) of the function at given time(s).

Parameters:

t (float or array-like) – The time(s) at which to evaluate the left limit(s).

Returns:

value – The value(s) of the left limit(s).

Return type:

list

maximal_time()¶

Returns the maximum time in the function.

Returns:

The maximum time, or -inf if no times are defined.

Return type:

float

minimal_time()¶

Returns the minimum time in the function.

Returns:

The minimum time, or +inf if no times are defined.

Return type:

float

non_dimension_jump_times(return_index=False)¶

Returns the jump times at which the dimension does not change.

Parameters:

return_index (bool, optional) – If True, also return the indices of the non-dimension jump times.

Returns:

  • non_dimension_jump_times (list) – The jump times at which there are no dimension jumps.

  • non_dimension_jump_indices (list, optional) – The indices of the non-dimension jump times, if requested.

norm(t=None, order=None, return_times=False)¶

Computes the norm of the function values at given time(s).

Computes the norm of the function values at given time(s) or at all times, if no time is provided.

Parameters:

  • t (float, list, or None, optional) – The time point(s) at which to evaluate the norm.

  • order (int or None, optional) – The order of the norm to compute.

  • return_times (bool, optional) – If True, return the corresponding times with the norms.

Returns:

  • value_norms (list) – The computed norms.

  • times (list, optional) – The corresponding times, if requested.

plot_coordinates(title='Plot of the coordinates', legend=True, labels=None, xlabel='Time', ylabel='Value', separate_plots=False, sharex=True, sharey=True, grid=False, show_jump_times=False, show_dimension_jump_times=False)¶

Plots the coordinate values of the function against time.

Parameters:

  • title (str, optional) – The title of the plot.

  • sharex (bool, optional) – If True, share the x-axis among separate plots.

  • sharey (bool, optional) – If True, share the y-axis among separate plots.

  • grid (bool, optional) – If True, show grid lines on the plot.

  • show_jump_times (bool, optional) – If True, indicate jump times on the plot.

  • show_dimension_jump_times (bool, optional) – If True, indicate dimension jump times on the plot.

fig – The figure object created.

Return type:

FigureObject

class numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.function_vd.StatsFunctionsOfVariableDimension(t_span, stepsize=1, t_eval=None, order=2, collect_jump_times=False, collect_dimension_jump_times=False)¶

A class to compute and store statistics of functions of variable dimension.

evaluated_functions¶

Count of the functions evaluated.

Type:

int

times¶

A list of time points for evaluations.

Type:

list

order¶

A list of orders for norms to be computed.

Type:

list

norm_means¶

Means of the norms for each order over time. The array has the shape (len(order), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

norm_variances¶

Sample variances of the norms for each order over time. The array has the shape (len(order), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

norm_m2¶

Sum of squared differences of the norms for each order over time. The array has the shape (len(order), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

dimension_means¶

Means of the dimension over time. The array has the length len(times).

Type:

np.ndarray

dimension_variances¶

Sample variances of the dimension over time. The array has the length len(times).

Type:

np.ndarray

dimension_m2¶

Sum of squared differences of the dimension for each order over time. The array has the length len(times).

Type:

np.ndarray

custom_evaluation_functions¶

List of user-provided functions to evaluate.

Type:

list of callables

cef_means¶

Means of the custom evaluation functions over time. The array has the shape (len(custom_evaluation_functions), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

cef_variances¶

Sample variances of the custom evaluation functions over time. The array has the shape (len(custom_evaluation_functions), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

cef_m2¶

Sum of squared differences of the custom evaluation functions over time. The array has the shape (len(custom_evaluation_functions), len(times)).

Type:

np.ndarray

collect_jump_times¶

Indicates whether jump times are stored.

Type:

bool

jump_times¶

List of all jump times of evaluated functions. Exists only, when collect_jump_times is True.

Type:

list of lists

collect_dimension_jump_times¶

Indicates whether dimension jump times are stored.

Type:

bool

dimension_jump_times¶

List of all dimension jump times of evaluated functions. Exists only, when collect_dimension_jump_times is True.

Type:

list of lists

Adds a custom evaluation function to be evaluated later.

func (callable) – The custom evaluation function to add.

Raises:

ValueError – If functions have already been added.

Adds a function to the statistics collector for evaluation.

Parameters:

  • ValueError – If the function’s time range does not match the collector’s.

static list_difference(list1, list2)¶

Remove list1 from list2 if it is a sublist.

Parameters:

  • list1 (list of lists) – List that contains the elements to be removed.

  • list2 (list of lists) – List where the elements from list1 should be removed from.

Returns:

result – List that contains all elements in list2, but not in list1, accounting for multiple entrances.

Return type:

list

Raises:

ValueError – If list1 is not a sublist of list2.
